aboutTimeline.title: Born 2 Weeks Early in a Lift
aboutTimeline.desc: Steve entered the world 2 weeks early in an elevator lift at Leicester Royal Infirmary on Friday the 13th—setting the tone for a resilient life.

aboutTimeline.title: Started 34-Year Tech Career
aboutTimeline.desc: Began programming and hardware systems engineering at 17, building foundational IT network protocols and software systems.

aboutTimeline.title: 5 Years in Dubai (UAE)
aboutTimeline.desc: Lived and worked in Dubai for 5 years as Lead Enterprise Cloud Architect for News Group International and Mediawatch Dubai.

aboutTimeline.title: Gatwick Crisis & Phoenix Tattoo
aboutTimeline.desc: Returning home from Dubai, Steve suffered cardiac arrest on the plane as it landed at Gatwick Airport. Simultaneously contracting MRSA and Pneumonia, medical teams gave near-zero odds of survival. Defying all predictions, Steve survived—commemorating his rebirth with his iconic Phoenix Tattoo on his chest.

aboutTimeline.title: Sobriety & Founding KEEP ME SOBER TOO (KMST)
aboutTimeline.desc: Sober since 2013 (13 years of continuous recovery). Steve founded KEEP ME SOBER TOO (KMST) to support individuals struggling with addiction and help their families navigate recovery.

aboutTimeline.title: Actor & Enterprise IT Architect
aboutTimeline.desc: Combining 34 years of tech expertise with professional screen acting in major commercials (Snickers with Saka & Modrić) and TV productions (Ted Lasso, The Witcher, BBC Doctors).
